title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Does the API support Multi-level Expand (Multi layers)
summary: The Business Central REST API supports multi-level expand (nested data retrieval) using nested parentheses in $expand syntax, allowing you to retrieve related resources across multiple layers, and also supports combining multi-level expands with filters and field selection.
key_points: Multi-level expand uses nested parentheses syntax like $expand=salesOrderLines($expand=item($expand=itemCategory))
You can expand multiple entities simultaneously and combine two-level expands with multi-level nested expands in a single query
Filter expressions and $select clauses can be added at each expansion level to retrieve only necessary fields
Each additional level of nesting requires an extra set of parentheses in the query structure

quotes.text: each additional level of expansion requires an extra set of parentheses: $expand=salesOrderLines($expand=item($expand=itemCategory))
quotes.why_it_matters: This clearly explains the syntax pattern for multi-level expand queries, essential for developers constructing nested API calls

quotes.text: You can also expand multiple entities simultaneously, such as combining a two-level expand with a multi-level (three-level) nested expand.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that developers can mix multiple expansion paths in a single query for efficient data retrieval

quotes.text: you can also include a $select clause at each level to retrieve only the necessary fields
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that optimization is possible by limiting returned fields at each nesting level, reducing payload size
